title: Population
question: Do known outcomes represent the lending decision?
decision: Retain resolved accepted loans and sample across chunks.
consequence: Makes labels observable but conditions the population on resolution.
uncertainty: Recent cohorts have incomplete and unequal follow-up.

title: Drift and missingness
question: Will older-loan relationships survive in later data?
decision: Use a chronological split and training-fitted missingness indicators.
consequence: Tests transfer while preserving systematic absence patterns.
uncertainty: Missingness may describe collection era; full-sample EDA exposed holdout patterns.

title: Feature meaning
question: Does the transformation express a relevant borrower quantity?
decision: Consolidate FICO and derive elapsed history and loan-to-income.
consequence: Reduces redundancy and makes history/burden interpretable.
uncertainty: The stated monotonicity admission rule is not enforced.

title: Model complexity
question: Does the complex model earn a stronger claim?
decision: Compare application XGBoost and logistic with paired AUC intervals.
consequence: The zero-crossing interval leaves the simpler model credible.
uncertainty: One test cohort does not establish future equivalence or superiority.

title: Incumbent information
question: Do borrower fields add beyond LC assessment?
decision: Evaluate separate application, LC-only and combined information sets.
consequence: Combined results show complementary ranking information.
uncertainty: Some comparisons change estimator as well as fields.

title: Calibration transfer
question: Can the probability adjustment be used on a later cohort?
decision: Fit Platt scaling on validation and apply it unchanged to test.
consequence: Improves test ECE but leaves average overprediction.
uncertainty: A correction fitted to one base rate does not eliminate drift.

title: Loss and price
question: Does probability explain realised principal loss?
decision: Measure training LGD and compare predicted and realised loss by risk group.
consequence: Shows that PD overprediction can coexist with loss underprediction.
uncertainty: Severity, weights and annual-looking pricing horizons need separate validation.

title: Serving information
question: Is a default-filled profile the same prediction problem?
decision: Recompute current-input loan-to-income and test masking of uncollected fields.
consequence: Creates a valid row but loses ranking performance in the diagnostic.
uncertainty: Exact browser/API mapping and a reduced-feature model need their own study.

title: Release activation
question: What establishes that the intended model is actually running?
decision: Stop activation when preflight memory headroom is inadequate.
consequence: Keeps a prepared candidate separate from a verified active release.
uncertainty: Recovery and hosted parity still need recorded results.
